gapTasks.title: Card template two-sided completion contract

baselineReality.detail: Declared BackupOnly/NoConflict, so template rows never travel through row sync even though name is a UNIQUE business key. HTML/CSS live in front_template/back_template/css_style; there are no insert/update/delete change-log triggers because no row is expected to sync.

gapTasks.targetDifference: Templates become portable rows with an explicit conflict policy, a version counter for concurrent edits, and a render check on both ends; Android renders the same template for the same card group.
desktopCapture: classify custom_anki_templates and its field payloads
export row fixture plus rendered front/back bytes
define tombstone/rename behaviour for template names
pathRules: template HTML/CSS references media by file name; resolution uses the Anki media root recorded in the media task
secretLocalRules: template content is non-secret portable data

acceptance.normal: edit a template on desktop → Android renders the same card group after pull; edit on Android → desktop re-renders identically
acceptance.exceptional: concurrent template edits converge on the business key without silently dropping CSS

gapTasks.title: Media progress, subtitles and study timing completion

acceptance.exceptional: replaying the same event vector twice yields identical aggregate counters
